title: Console Reporting Playbook: Triage & Prioritization for Enterprise Cost Exports, Dashboards, and Usage Analytics
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Triage incoming enterprise requests for Console-level reporting: scheduled/exportable cost breakdowns, team-scoped usage dashboards, raw telemetry export (S3/Snowflake), and CSV/JSON schedules. This ticket centralizes intake, decision criteria, and a proposed priority roadmap for Q2 2026. Goal: create a repeatable playbook so PM can rapidly decide scope and hand off clear requirements to ENG + Design for implementation. Scope excludes billing system integration and pricing changes; focuses on observability, exports, and reporting UX in Console.
acceptance_criteria: Clear prioritization rubric documented and approved by GTM and Security
Owner and engineering dependencies confirmed for top three requests
Draft PRD with wireframes and API contract for scheduled exports exists
Pilot export pipeline defined (S3 CSV and Snowflake CDC-compatible JSON) with data schema
Customer pilot list (3 enterprise pilot customers) committed and NDA checks completed
steps: Consolidate incoming customer requests (Zendesk, CSM notes, inbound sales emails)
Classify requests by persona: finance, infra/platform, feature teams
Score each request using rubric (security risk, engineering effort, revenue impact, churn risk)
Propose top-MVP scope and optional stretch features
Align with Eng on feasibility & effort; get rough T-shirt estimates
Prepare PRD + design brief and schedule 2-week discovery spike
Identify pilot customers and privacy/contract blockers
Track progress in weekly PM-ENG sync and update stakeholders
comments: 2026-02-21: Initial intake done—12 unique customer asks consolidated (examples: scheduled cost CSV exports, per-team cost attributions, long-term retention policy). Submitted summary to GTM.
2026-02-25: Scoring rubric v0.1 reviewed with Finance and CSM. Changed revenue weight from 15%->25% after feedback from Sales.
2026-03-01: Eng spike requested. ENG-2921 (export infra prototype) assigned to backend team. Ravi suggested S3-first approach for MVP to reduce compliance surface.

2026-03-04: Design sync—DES-429 allocated to Emily Park for dashboard UI proposals (team filters, time window, cost breakdown tree). Emily recommends drilldown by route & model-slice instead of token-level by default.

2026-03-07: Security input: exporting token-level logs raises PII concerns; require token redaction and schema that excludes prompt/response bodies. Security flagged KMS integration for S3 exports -> security review required.

2026-03-10: Decided MVP scope: scheduled S3 CSV exports (account/team/model path), on-demand CSV export from Console, and a per-team cost dashboard with 90-day retention for metrics. Stretch: Snowflake connector and row-level RBAC.

2026-03-12: Pilot customers identified: Acme Health (enterprise), Ledgerly (fintech), NovaApps (platform). CSMs to confirm NDA and data export permissions this week. Added ENG-3057 for retention/rollups.
Action items: Ravi to produce rough architecture doc; Maya to finalize PRD draft and share with Security and Sales by 2026-03-16.
